preview_method: Blender 5.2.2 Cycles CPU, 24 samples, identical front/quarter/detail camera and lighting; display translation only
quality: 1024 preferred. 512 retains silhouette/base colors but loses upholstery button/seam and wood-edge detail; both inherit SF3D uneven feet. Normal texture exists and is shaded; no new gross normal-map corruption observed.
limitations: Single chair, one replica, four requests; not p95 or a multi-input benchmark.
Previous 59.53s was a first prediction; no previous warm-repeat control exists.
No algorithm/dtype/geometry change, no dummy inference and no extra requests.
CUDA coarse-boundary timing adds synchronization overhead shared across A/B/C/D.
Cold first-pass costs are spread across DINO, UV, estimator and other CUDA stages; no specific deterministic >5s cache was established.
Full capture-to-mesh/first-proxy latency and deployed Worker savings not measured.
B04 dimensions use the prior software target, not independently measured physical chair dimensions.
